name: Hinanagi Tsumuji
source: A tsundere girl at school she's a friend of [url=http://vndb.org/c5760]Toua[/url]. She's part of the student council and gets upset whenever [url=http://vndb.org/c5766]Haruto[/url] is late to school or breaks a rule. She is also a childhood friend of [url=http://vndb.org/c5765]Kotarou[/url] and is secretely in love with him.
